verdict.rationale: Nitrokey makes hardware security keys and HSMs (FIDO2, OpenPGP, PIV, NetHSM), not an AI agent or assistant. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in servers and calls their tools is a category error for this product type, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
